findings.description: Submitting the Add expense form with a whitespace-only title passes the browser's required check, the server rejects it with HTTP 400, and the page re-renders as an empty Add expense form with no error message, so the user gets no explanation and the typed values are cleared.
repro: Enter three spaces in Title, enter 1 in Amount, pick a category
Observe: the response is 400, the page shows a blank Add expense form at /expenses with no error text and the inputs are empty

findings.description: At phone widths (max-width 600px) the stylesheet hides the table header and sets table, tbody, tr and td to display:block, so the Title/Category/Amount cells have no visible or programmatic column labels; amounts and categories are unlabeled for screen-reader users.
repro: Sign in as viewer-3cfd and open /expenses
Observe the list rendered as stacked blocks with no column headings; inspect thead computed display (none) and table display (block)

notes: Tested both roles at 360 and 1280 px: login, list, category filter, totals (verified by hand: all-items $399.99, travel $185.25, meals $177.25), add and edit recalculation, delete recalculation, viewer access to /expenses/new and /expenses/1/edit (403), keyboard focus outline, contrast of the main palette. No other defects found. Not tested: full axe audit, screen reader, touch gestures, network throttling, and other categories beyond visual/a11y. Test data was modified (one expense edited to 50.00 and one added then deleted).

cost.notes: estimate from 32530 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0039
